projectDescription: AppBlips is a text-to-app generator that turns plain-English descriptions into working, single-file React apps with a live preview — available at appblips.com, or run locally for your own use.
keyFeatures: Plain-English prompt builds a working single-file React app in seconds
Instant live preview with sandboxed iframe rendering
Refine apps with follow-up prompts and undo/redo version history
Attach images or screenshots as reference material for generation
AI-powered features inside generated apps via the blip.ai.text() API
Mobile and desktop viewport previews with adjustable zoom
Export any app as a single self-contained HTML file
Deploy to a public URL as an installable PWA (hosted mode)
Visual element editor for point-and-click style changes
Configurable reasoning effort (Off / Low / Medium / High)
Local self-hosted copy (Node.js or Docker) with no sign-in required
BYOK and relay modes for generated-app AI access
publicApiSurface: blip.ai.text(messages, options) — call AI from inside a generated app
blip.ai.configure() — open the BYOK provider configuration dialog
blip.ai.isConfigured() — check whether an AI provider is connected
blip.ai.clearConfiguration() — disconnect the AI provider
BLIP.AI.TEXT(messages, options) — uppercase alias for blip.ai.text
POST /api/chat — builder LLM proxy endpoint
POST /api/app-ai/chat — generated-app AI relay endpoint
APPBLIPS_LLM_BASE_URL — OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint for the builder
APPBLIPS_LLM_API_KEY — API key for the builder LLM
APPBLIPS_LLM_MODEL — model name for the builder LLM
APPBLIPS_LLM_MAX_TOKENS — optional token cap for builder responses
APPBLIPS_LLM_TEMPERATURE — sampling temperature for the builder (default 0.2)
APPBLIPS_CHAT_RATE_LIMIT_MAX — max requests per window on /api/chat
APPBLIPS_CHAT_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS — rate-limit window in seconds
APPBLIPS_GENERATED_AI_MODE — byok (default) or relay mode for app AI
APPBLIPS_APP_AI_RELAY_URL — public URL of the generated-app AI relay
APPBLIPS_APP_AI_MAX_TOKENS — token cap for AI calls made by generated apps (provider is always the builder's)
APPBLIPS_APP_AI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS — CORS allowlist for cross-origin relay callers
APPBLIPS_APP_AI_RATE_LIMIT_MAX — per-IP rate limit for the app AI relay
SELF_HOSTED_MODE — toggle between hosted and self-hosted operating modes
